InitialCourse.title: Start with confidence
InitialCourse.description: From your first moments behind the wheel to independent city driving. Learn step by step, at a pace that works for you.
InitialCourse.label: For new drivers
InitialCourse.body: Start on a safe training ground, get comfortable with the controls, then put your skills into practice in city traffic. Your instructor adapts the training plan to your experience.
InitialCourse.skill1: Seating position, steering and smooth use of the controls
InitialCourse.skill2: Moving off, hill starts, acceleration and controlled braking
InitialCourse.skill3: Reversing, turning in narrow spaces and parking
InitialCourse.skill4: Planning a route and anticipating other road users
InitialCourse.schoolLabel: On a school car · fuel included
InitialCourse.validity: Prices listed by REGA are valid through 30 November 2026. Confirm the current price and your individual plan when booking.

About.title: Confidence comes from practice.
About.description: Taras Rega’s driving school in Lviv helps drivers and motorcyclists build skills, understand their vehicles and make more considered decisions on the road.
About.storyTitle: Experience from motorsport. A focus on everyday driving.
About.storyBody: REGA was founded by Taras Rega, whose background combines professional sport education, rally competition and coaching. That experience informs the school’s approach to vehicle control and learning through practice.
About.storyPurpose: The aim is practical: help each student understand their starting point, develop sound technique and recognise situations that need a safer decision. Training ranges from first driving lessons to advanced car and motorcycle control.
About.individualBody: Your experience, confidence and goals guide the programme. Exercises and feedback help identify the skills that need attention.
About.practiceBody: Practise on a specially equipped closed training ground, then use suitable road routes where the programme includes them. Review your actions with an instructor.
About.progressBody: A progression of programmes lets you start with the fundamentals, return after a break or continue developing more advanced techniques.
About.tryBody: A free trial lesson gives you a chance to meet an instructor, try introductory exercises and discuss a suitable programme. Advance booking is required.
